notes: Two listed classes on the SIX Swiss Exchange: bearer shares (RO.SW) and, since 17 March 2026, participation certificates (ROG.SW), which replaced the non-voting equity securities one-for-one and carry the same dividend and liquidation rights as the bearer shares (Half-Year Report 2026). The Yahoo symbols are not stated in Roche's reports; ROG.SW is the line that previously priced the non-voting equity securities. The OTC ADR (RHHBY, eight ADRs per underlying security) is not used. Shares outstanding exclude own equity instruments held by the Group for equity compensation plans, which the half-year report states only in millions (0.4 million shares, 12.1 million participation certificates), so the deductions are rounded to the nearest 100,000. The half-year report at 30 June 2026 is the latest interim report; Roche publishes no quarterly share count.
